model: game lines: adjusted-margin ratings fit jointly with home field, normal distribution over the game margin. Moneylines outside -600 to +600 are not bet, spread underdogs of more than +24 are not bet, and a game is skipped when the projection lands more than 28 points of margin from the market's own line. player props: per-player game logs with recency weighting, shrunk toward a league baseline and adjusted for the defence, priced with gamma (yardage), negative binomial (counts) or Poisson (anytime TD). half-point lines only; totals are not priced; games starting within 7 days
